items.summary: The Inter-Ministerial Group (IMG), chaired by the Secretary, Department of Public Enterprises (DPE), and co-chaired by the Secretary, Department of Telecommunications (DoT), has recommended asset monetisation proposals involving assets valued at over ₹1,100 crore for consideration and approval by the Alternative Mechanism (AM).
items.title: Inter-Ministerial Group Recommends Asset Monetisation Proposals Worth Over ₹1,100 Crore for Approval by Cabinet-Delegated Alternative Mechanism

items.summary: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today inaugurated the Martyrs’ Memorial of the First War of Independence of 1857 in Ambala, Haryana. On this occasion, Haryana Chief Minister Shri Nayab Singh Saini and Union Minister Shri Manohar Lal, along with many other dignitaries, were present.
items.title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah inaugurates Martyrs’ Memorial of First War of Independence of 1857 in Ambala, Haryana
